subject: science
passage: During the Antarctic winter, male emperor penguins guarding eggs crowd together in huddles of hundreds or even thousands of birds. Inside a dense huddle, the air is far warmer than outside, while birds on the windward edge bear the full force of the cold. Huddles slowly shift, however, as birds on the exposed side move along the edge and rejoin the group elsewhere. Researchers who tracked individual penguins found that, over a whole winter, nearly all of them spent similar amounts of time at the edge and in the center. This finding suggests that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: the penguins on the edge of a huddle are mostly those that have lost their eggs.
choices.B: the strongest males manage to keep the warm center of the huddle for themselves.
choices.C: huddling raises the temperature of the air around the whole breeding colony.
choices.D: the warmth inside a huddle is shared fairly evenly among the birds over time.

explanation.why: The text says the center of a huddle is warm and the edge is cold, and that huddles shift so birds keep changing places. Tracking showed that nearly all birds spent "similar amounts of time at the edge and in the center." Together, these facts mean each bird gets a roughly equal share of the warm interior over the winter.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The text never mentions birds losing their eggs.
explanation.B: Incorrect. If a few birds kept the center, they would spend more time there than others, which the tracking did not find.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The text describes warmth inside a huddle, not a change in the air around the colony.
explanation.D: Correct. Similar time in the warm center and the cold edge means the warmth is shared fairly evenly.
